task.title: Phase N N6.6: visual-assertion calibration harness in the non-packaged acceptance build and benchmark:visual-assertion
task.objective: Implement awkit-vra.15.6 per VA-12 and VA-16: a calibration root that runs only in the main process of the non-packaged acceptance build (built to out/calibration-main, excluded from packaging, refusing a packaged app), real headed and headless Chromium per render-mode x DPR cell through the real VisualAssertionStep adapter on the mock-site Visual Assertion Lab, one fresh launch per trial, every launch's trials persisted per session, the pure VA-12 criterion (>= 300 passed primary trials over >= 3 sessions, zero failed, every negative failed in >= 30 launches, moved/clipped/interaction always inconclusive, zero captures on refusals, p95 within 2000 ms) decided over all sessions of the same environment, and issueGrantUnchecked only for a cell meeting every criterion; benchmark:visual-assertion launches it; verify:visual-calibration proves the criterion, the packaging exclusion and that no production entry, IPC, setting or run reaches grant issuance.

acceptance.description: The calibration root refuses a packaged app, is excluded from packaging and unreachable from the production entry and IPC; the VA-12 criterion decision table and its mutants pass; grants are issued only for a cell whose recorded evidence meets every criterion.
benchmark:visual-assertion sessions run real launches and record per-cell evidence; each cell is reported qualified or unqualified with its unmet criteria.

evidence.observed: 43/0 with mutants C1 (failed primary ignored) and C2 (environment filter ignored) red and reverted; runtime 86/0, grants 45/0, isolation 90/0, classification 352
tsc --noEmit and electron-vite build; build:calibration emits out/calibration-main (excluded from packaging)

21 sessions, 2138 real launches, all six cells qualified (primary passed 325-387, failed 0, bound 0.77-0.92 percent, p95 989-1342 ms), six dev grants issued; one hung three-lane session stopped, its launches kept
